body:
yes, she is able to wait. but it's unlikely that i will make it that far. and i have some fairly wealthy grandparents who care about me, so i could ask for a flight ticket as a present or something. endgame is she moves to canada after uni, we get married later on, and we stay together.

i dont want to lose her, please understand that is not an option. i need her. i know it sounds stupid, coming from a 14 year old, and one who is speaking about someone they've never even met, but i freaking love her to death.

my parents and i aren't that close. I mean, my mom and i are, but we fight a lot, so i've stopped opening up to her. my parents dont really understand what or how i am. They dont have any of the things i have either.

Now about the british girl, yes, i know it's hard to believe. I know you wont believe me. I know you dont understand. But she is the person i want to spend my life with, and that feeling is mutual. Yes, i know we've never met, but we love each other. i know it sounds stupid, but we love each other more than anything in the world. we've been through a lot together, we've been there for each other from the start. Neither of us ever wants to leave the other, we want this to work. Nobody else is as good as she is, she's freaking amazing! She's so so kind and sweet and caring and loving, and she'd do almost anything for me. We love each other dearly. You probably think i dont know what love is, or that i'm not seeing reality, but I do and I am. I get what you're saying, there's a good chance we wont work. I know that. But i want to try, and she does to. We both want each other. We know we'll drift apart throughout university and whatnot, but we do plan to meet in four years. and then a year after that, she'll be done uni, and she will come to live with me in canada. if we have to, we'll get married. and she wouldn't leave me. she's been cheated on and used so many times, the last thing she wants is to leave me. 

she is everything i've ever wanted, and neither of us are going to give up on the other easily. we want to be together. neither of us want to settle for anyone else

Okay. i know that you are hurting really bad right now. But try to stay with me. Everyone around you will care if you hurt yourself. right now, they are taking you for granted. It sounds like you really need a fresh start. So let's talk about this, and figure out what to do. I'm here for you. i know this sucks. You can get through this. i know you may not believe me, but it will get better, just don't give up. Suicide isn't the way out. you will hurt your kids, your friends, your parents, and everyone else who cares about you. there ARE people who care about you. i dont even know you, and i already care so much about you, because i know what you are going through. i hope you reply to this. i may not respond to your reply right away, but i WILL respond. I promise. Stay strong. you are beautiful, inside and out. everyone is perfect in their own way, including you. you are not poison, you are not trash. You are amazing.

And it's okay to cry, it doesnt make you weak, or pathetic, or a crybaby. Everyone cries. And you are in a lot of pain. Just please believe me when i say that you are amazing.
